name: ingress_5xx
description: ingress-nginx access-log lines whose response status is 5xx. Anchored on the status after the request line; an unanchored " 5xx " also matches the request-length field.

name: eso_reconcile_errors
description: External Secrets Operator reconcile failures (the controller's own error log line).

name: job_warning_events
description: Kubernetes Warning events on Jobs and CronJobs in commonly-dev (BackoffLimitExceeded, DeadlineExceeded, FailedCreate). The managed kube-state-metrics package exports no Job or CronJob series, so a failed backup is visible only here. UnexpectedJob is excluded: the CronJob controller emits it for every Job made with `kubectl create job --from=cronjob/...`, which Deploy Dev does for the stranger journey on every deploy (5 events paged on 2026-10-15, 13:48Z; no other reason in 7 days).
filter: logName:"logs/events" AND resource.type="k8s_cluster" AND jsonPayload.involvedObject.namespace="commonly-dev" AND jsonPayload.involvedObject.kind=("Job" OR "CronJob") AND jsonPayload.type="Warning" AND NOT jsonPayload.reason="UnexpectedJob"

name: litellm_platform_call_failures
description: LiteLLM access-log lines where an in-cluster platform caller (backend, commonly-bot) got a 4xx/5xx on /chat/completions. In-cluster callers use http://litellm:4000/chat/completions; public traffic only reaches /v1/... through the ingress, so internet probes are excluded. Counted after LiteLLM's own fallbacks, so it fires when a feature actually got no answer.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="commonly-dev" AND resource.labels.container_name="litellm" AND textPayload=~"\"POST /chat/completions HTTP/1.1\" [45][0-9][0-9]"

name: stranger_journey_failures
description: Stranger-journey runs that ended with result=fail (one JSON line per run from k8s/helm/commonly/files/stranger-journey.py). The failed step and its error are in the same log line.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="commonly-dev" AND resource.labels.container_name="journey" AND jsonPayload.journey="stranger" AND jsonPayload.result="fail"

name: stranger_journey_passes
description: Stranger-journey runs that ended with result=pass. Its absence is the alert: a run killed by a spot reclaim or the 900 s deadline prints no verdict at all, so a failure counter alone cannot see it.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="commonly-dev" AND resource.labels.container_name="journey" AND jsonPayload.journey="stranger" AND jsonPayload.result="pass"

name: user_spend_over_threshold
description: A user's priced model spend for the UTC day crossed SPEND_ALARM_USD_PER_DAY (default $2). One line per user per day from backend/services/spendAlarmService.ts; the userId, the amount and the token split are in the same log line.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="commonly-dev" AND resource.labels.container_name="backend" AND jsonPayload.alarm="user_spend"

name: litellm_key_budget_near_limit
description: A LiteLLM virtual key passed 80% of its max_budget (TASK-555). One line per key per budget period from backend/services/litellmBudgetAlarmService.ts; the key alias, spend, budget and reset time are in the same log line.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="commonly-dev" AND resource.labels.container_name="backend" AND jsonPayload.alarm="litellm_budget"
